sources.entry: Total Spaces - Workspace manager with hotkeys and spatial overview.

summary.name: TotalSpaces2
summary.one_liner: TotalSpaces2 is a grid-based spaces (virtual desktop) manager for macOS that adds an overview of desktops, grid navigation, and customizable transitions and hotkeys.
keywords: navigate desktops left right up down
use_cases: Organizing many macOS desktops into a grid
Switching desktops with hotkeys or swipes
Keeping specific apps on specific desktops
Triggering desktop overview from screen corners
summary.what_it_does: TotalSpaces2 lets you display an overview of your Mac's desktops and drag windows between them. You define a grid of desktops and navigate left, right, up and down between them. Transitions and hotkeys are customizable. Swiping between desktops and hot corners that open the overview grid are also supported. Apps can be assigned to particular desktops so they open where you want them.
notable: Grid-based desktop layout with directional navigation
Overview of desktops with drag-and-drop of windows between them
Hot corners to trigger the overview grid
